dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Continuous and symmetrical 2D geometric narrowing from the maximum mid-body width toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins are predominantly smooth with a minor, localized protrusion on the left mid-to-posterior edge.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Median pixel intensity aligns with a light slate-grey skin tone across the dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse darker grey clusters distributed across the posterior half of the dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Gradient slope between pigmented regions and the primary light-grey baseline is diffuse and gradual.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Multiple fine, high-contrast white linear markings (rake marks) on the central and mid-dorsal plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Superficial linear rake marks visible across the mid-dorsal surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Well-defined, open blowhole visible at the anterior dorsal apex.
